{{Top|leg}}
'''Hu's Emporium''' was a weapons shop located in the grimy underbelly of [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]]. Owned by a [[Paigun]] named [[Kitak Hu]], Hu's Emporium catered towards [[Droid/Legends|droids]], which were often targets for theft on the crime-ridden "Gambler's World." Hu specialized in selling weapon harnesses that were outfitted with automatic weapons, so they could be used even by droids not programmed for combat.
